record.summary: The daemon stops dying of success: a terminal run drops it to standby, still serving the API, instead of exiting the process. Above the per-run loop sits a scheduler over the project registry (025): armed, qualified projects with ready work get a fresh run, serviced serially in registration order, with at most one live stage session globally. A bounded standby scan refreshes the registry and each armed project's spec DAG, so new pending specs wake a run automatically per 010 D14. Quota parking is global: the account's quota is one pool, so no project starts a session while parked. Runs, journals, and recovery semantics from 013, 011, and 021 are unchanged; the daemon simply outlives them.
record.title: Standby daemon and the multi-project scheduler
